title: A remote kb server takes feedback only when turned on, and a remote report counts only once approved
goal: kb_http.py and kb_mcp.py --roots list no kb_feedback unless started with --feedback (D-kyy5xgsw: off by default); with it, a remote report is spooled as pending with origin remote, capped at a daily count, and enters distill, learn and apply only after an explicit approval that a human operator or an agent gives (the approval records which: by operator or by agent), as the remote-approval gate settles; a pending report is never researched, aliased or expanded, and one never approved goes with the spool's age limit; the startup line on stderr says feedback is on.

run:
import subprocess, sys, json
def names(extra):
    req = json.dumps(dict(jsonrpc='2.0', id=1, method='tools/list', params=dict()))
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kb_mcp.py', '--roots', 'public'] + extra, input=req + chr(10), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=25)
    got = [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('{')]
    return [t['name'] for g in got for t in g.get('result', dict()).get('tools', [])]
off, on = names([]), names(['--feedback'])
usage = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/querylog.py', '--help'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=25)
print('off', 'kb_feedback' in off, 'on', 'kb_feedback' in on)
ok = len(off) > 0 and 'kb_feedback' not in off and 'kb_feedback' in on and 'approve' in (usage.stdout + usage.stderr)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

gates.question: What does one explicit approval of remote feedback cover? (D-kyy5xgsw: off by default, approval by a human operator or an agent)
options: each report: remote reports wait as pending until querylog.py feedback approve FB-ID --by operator|agent
the server: starting kb_http.py --feedback asks the operator or an agent to confirm once, and its reports then count
both: the start is confirmed once and each report is approved
gates.recommendation: each report: remote reports wait as pending until querylog.py feedback approve FB-ID --by operator|agent
gates.answer: each report: remote reports wait as pending until querylog.py feedback approve FB-ID --by operator|agent
